title: Verify candidate occurrences and cover all requested evidence roles
when: A semantic selector/reranker receives pre-parsed source candidates.
do: Generate exact occurrences from pinned bytes; attach source hash, selector and verbatim occurrence, not a model-authored line description.
Validate hash and exact span before any paid decision; model confidence cannot validate source truth.
Split a question into evidence facets such as actual behavior, negative capability and documented alternative. Enumerate candidates for every facet before narrowing.
Keep metadata descriptions and source occurrences as different types. Missing candidates remain coverage gaps; a selector cannot recover omitted sources.
Record returned, native-applied, superseded and actually-used decisions separately; retain actor/consumer identities and failed steps.
check: No candidate points to text different from its described source occurrence.
Each requested evidence facet has source candidates or an explicit gap.
Superseded or failed applications are excluded from accepted evidence.
limitation: This trial found candidate/coverage and native binding limitations. It does not establish general Jev/model quality or a causal speedup.
